title: The geometric series sum x^n is Cauchy for any ratio 0<=x<1
statement: CReal.geomCauchyOfLt generalizes the fixed-ratio-1/2 CReal.geomCauchy to an arbitrary ratio x with 0<=x<1 (given an explicit positivity-bound witness for 1-x), establishing CReal.Cauchy (sumRange (fun n => x^n)). Eliminates the Nat.le_total disjunction via geomCauchyOfLtOrdered at whichever of (m,n)/(n,m) satisfies its own ordered side condition, exactly as geomCauchy's fixed-ratio proof does.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.geomCauchyOfLt : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal.le CReal.zero x0) -> ((x2 : CReal.lt x0 CReal.one) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : CReal.PosBound (CReal.add CReal.one (CReal.neg x0)) x3) -> CReal.Cauchy (CReal.sumRange (fun (x5 : AxNat) => CReal.pow x0 x5)))))))
